**NWA-360** · Bug · Priority: Medium · Status: Open
Reporter: Lucy Ashdown (Vale Rovers) · Components: membership-svc, fan-app

**Description**
Vale Rovers members cannot see their previous seasons' tickets or loyalty points in the Fan App. The history was not imported at go-live.
Loyalty points decide priority booking for away games, so members are calling the ticket office to complain. The first away ballot is on 20 October.
